asset: Company provided badges

1. Biometeric scnning along with required badge access
2. Abilitiy to deactivie badges once stolen or lost 
3. Immediate reporting of lost or sotlen laptops

asset: Storage items with Comapny IP
original_proposed_controls:
1. Encryption of password to access devices 
2. Safe storage of Hashes of data to make sure the data or files are unchanged
3. Storage and access to the devices along with an in-depth tracking of location of device

asset: Minecraft source code and game builds
original_proposed_controls:
1. Creating a firewall structure around the system to make it virtaully unbreakeable even by people with the correct acess codes
2. Making the source code only accessable from highly limited MAC Adresses.
3. Securing all valid MAC Adresses that can affect the source code and gamebuilds

asset: Microsoft account authentication and identity data
original_proposed_controls:
1. Encryption of users passwords 
2. Limited availability to the structure of the account authentication process
3. Securing of the physical servers that host the account data

asset: Customer PII and purchase records
original_proposed_controls:
1. Encryption of user passwods, emails, billing informaiton 
2. Focus on securing billing informaiton and not as much actual transactional information
3. Various unmarkerd servers around the world that host seperate partial data

asset: Minecraft Realms worlds and backups
original_proposed_controls:
1. Continously running scans and monitoring realm data for any intrusions (IDS systems)
2. Updating a true back up of the realm every 2 days when it is being used, and keeping backups up to 20 days before deleting.  
3. Make sure to keep access to the realm data limited to only higher management and support teams.

asset: Realms hosting infrastructure and databases
original_proposed_controls:
1. Continuously patch and harden hosting servers and databases
2. Limit production access with multi-factor authentication and least-privilege permissions
3. Maintain replicated backups and regularly test failover and data recovery

asset: Minecraft Marketplace and Minecoin transaction records
original_proposed_controls:
1. Encrypt Marketplace and Minecoin transaction records while stored and transmitted
2. Limit payment and Marketplace administrator access with multi-factor authentication
3. Continuously monitor transaction logs for fraud and unusual account activity

asset: Creator partner content and submission pipeline
original_proposed_controls:
1. Scan all creator submissions for malware and prohibited code before publication
2. Test creator content inside an isolated environment before approving the submission
3. Require verified creator accounts, version history, and approval before content is released

asset: Game update and software distribution systems
original_proposed_controls:
1. Digitally sign every game update and verify file hashes before distribution
2. Limit build and release permissions with multi-factor authentication and separate administrator accounts
3. Monitor distribution systems and maintain a tested rollback copy of the previous stable release

asset: Mojang employee accounts and collaboration systems
original_proposed_controls:
1. Require multi-factor authentication and unique passwords for employee accounts
2. Limit account permissions and regularly disable unused or former employee accounts
3. Train employees against phishing and alert security teams about unusual login activity

asset: Development workstations and code-signing credentials
original_proposed_controls:
1. Encrypt development workstations and continuously patch and monitor them with endpoint protection
2. Store code-signing credentials in protected hardware with access limited to approved employees
3. Require approval for release signing and keep an audit log of every use of the credentials

asset: Minecraft brand, trademarks, and licensing agreements
original_proposed_controls:
1. Store licensing agreements and trademark records in an encrypted centralized repository
2. Limit editing permissions and keep version history for all legal documents
3. Monitor for fraudulent domains, counterfeit content, and unauthorized use of the Minecraft brand

asset: Vulnerabilities and attacks sources on third-party cloud and platform vendor services
original_proposed_controls:
1. Perform security reviews of third-party vendors before granting access to Mojang systems
2. Require vendors to report vulnerabilities and incidents and to maintain supported, patched services
3. Maintain backups, alternate service options, and a documented plan for vendor outages

asset: Player chat, moderation, and trust-and-safety data
original_proposed_controls:
1. Encrypt chat and moderation records and restrict access to authorized trust-and-safety employees
2. Use automated filtering with human review and an easy process for players to report harmful content
3. Set retention limits and remove or anonymize player data when it is no longer needed

asset: Production monitoring, logs, and incident-response records
original_proposed_controls:
1. Store security logs in a centralized system that prevents unauthorized changes or deletion
2. Restrict log access with multi-factor authentication and least-privilege permissions
3. Back up important logs and regularly test incident-response procedures using recorded events

asset: Physical offices and on-site network equipment
original_proposed_controls:
1. Require badge access, visitor records, and camera monitoring for restricted office areas
2. Segment office networks and keep firewalls, wireless systems, and network equipment patched
3. Maintain an equipment inventory and lock servers and critical network devices in secure rooms

asset: Customer-support tickets and account-recovery records
original_proposed_controls:
1. Encrypt customer-support tickets and remove unnecessary payment or identity information
2. Verify a player's identity before account recovery and require multi-factor authentication for support employees
3. Limit ticket access, log employee activity, and delete records after a certain retention period

asset: Mojang public websites, APIs, and DNS records
original_proposed_controls:
1. Protect public websites and APIs with a web application firewall, limiting, and DDoS protection
2. Secure DNS and domain registrar accounts with multi-factor authentication and registry locks
3. Patch and scan public systems while continuously monitoring certificates, changes, and service availability
